resources.string: End-to-End Encrypted Messaging & Persistent Live Radar
Verify your mobile number to start encrypted chats, status updates, and live radar sharing.
Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted with AES-GCM-256. No one outside of this chat can read or listen to them.
Grant trusted contacts long-term live location access — they can view your real-time movement on the map anytime (even a year later) until you revoke permission.
